messages:
elaine: Quick sync  compact version history for mobile. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-history-mobile. Main goal: make rollback discoverable without pushing timeline off-screen.
noah: Love the stacked chips but on < 360px the timestamp overflows. Maybe truncate time to "5m" instead of "5 minutes ago".
elaine: Good call. Also thinking of collapsing long commit messages into a single line with ellipsis and a chevron to expand inline. Keeps vertical rhythm.
ria: Accessibility note: expanded commit content must be togglable by keyboard (Enter/Space) and have aria-expanded state.
noah: UX question  should rollback be inline per-entry or a persistent floating panic button? Inline feels contextual, floating is faster for emergencies.
elaine: Proposal: inline primary action + a sticky panic button that only appears after you select an entry (to avoid accidental taps). Sticky has bigger hit area.
ria: For the inline confirm modal: copy should be short and explicit. Suggest: "Rollback to v12.3? This will route traffic to the selected version.

Changes are reversible." Buttons: "Confirm rollback" (primary) and "Cancel". Confirm should include aria-describedby pointing to the risk text.
noah: Microcopy tweak  "Changes are reversible" sounds vague. Maybe "You can re-deploy previous versions if needed". Shorten to "Re-deployable"? Not sure.
elaine: Hmm keep plain language: "You can re-deploy later if this rollback doesn't fix the issue." Ria any A11y concerns with that phrasing?
ria: Fine. Make sure the modal focus trap announces the title and the risk copy. Use role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
ops-bot: snapshot: compact-history-mobile pushed to staging at http://staging.redwood/rollout-history (build 1733332300)
noah: Minor animation ask  when expanding commit, fade+slide up feels less jumpy. Keep duration 160ms.
elaine: Also add a subtle divider between entries when expanded so content doesn't feel glued.
ria: Color contrast check  collapse chevron needs 4.5:1 against bg in default state. If icon-only, provide focus ring.
elaine: I'll update the frames with truncated timestamps, one-line commit preview, inline rollback + sticky panic, and modal copy. Posting updated link shortly. Thanks! :sparkles:
